info.title: API.SH: MotorTrend
info.description: The MotorTrend API from API.SH: public MotorTrend data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One MotorTrend article: title, summary, authors, section, publish/update dates, reading time, tagged vehicles, highs/lows/verdict where the review has them, the article text and its headings, and the links it contains. Identify it by `url` or `id`. Free articles come back with their full text: in list and best-of articles the text of every entry (each list item or product pick, with its headline, text and image; product picks with pros, cons and retailer prices) is placed where the list sits and is also returned under `slides`. `access` is `free` or `subscribers`; a subscriber-only article returns its public opening (`preview_text`) instead of the full text.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-article

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The article's numeric id (display_id from /articles or /search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The newest articles of a MotorTrend section (news, reviews, features and others), newest first: title, summary, authors, section and subsection, publish and update dates, reading time, tagged vehicles and link. `subsection` keeps one subsection (e.g. comparison-test on reviews). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-articles

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Section slug (default news; e.g. news, reviews, features).

parameters.name: subsection
parameters.description: Only this subsection of the section.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every car make MotorTrend covers: make id (use it as `make` on /models), name, whether the make sells only EVs, and its page link. Current makes by default; `include_archived=true` adds makes no longer covered.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-makes

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One model with all its model years and the full detail of one year. Model: rating, price range, key properties (fuel, horsepower, mpg), the rankings it appears in, generations and every model year with its rating (MotorTrend Score), price and page link. Selected year (the current year unless `year` is given): MotorTrend Score out of 10 with its sub-scores (performance, efficiency/range, safety, tech/innovation, value) where published, MSRP range, highs, lows and verdict, EPA mpg/MPGe and range, seating, cargo, drivetrains, engines, warranties, every trim with its starting MSRP, key features and style ids (use them on /specs and /compare), MotorTrend's key specs table, its ranking, review link and photo galleries. Identify the model by `model_id`, by `make` and `model`, or by a model page `url`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-model

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A model page link on motortrend.com (instead of the ids).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Model year to detail (default the model's current year).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
All models of a make as MotorTrend lists them: model id (use it as `model_id` on /model), name, current or discontinued, latest model year, body style, fuel type, horsepower, EPA mpg or MPGe, price range, MotorTrend Score out of 10 with its sub-scores (performance, efficiency/range, safety, tech/innovation, value) where published, overview and the model's page link. Filter by `status` and `body_style`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-models

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: Only this body style (e.g. sedan, suv, hatchback, coupe, pickup, convertible, wagon, van).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One MotorTrend ranking, 10 vehicles per page in rank order: model id, make, model, year, MotorTrend Score, price range, fuel type, combined mpg/MPGe and range, highs, lows, verdict, summary, the vehicle's other rankings and its page link; plus the ranking's summary, FAQ, sub-rankings (for category pages) and past years. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-ranking

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A rankings page link (instead of path).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every published MotorTrend ranking (best cars, SUVs, trucks, EVs, by size, price, fuel and use; past years with `include_years=true`): title, path (use it on /ranking), type (category, subcategory or ranked list), number of ranked vehicles, parent ranking and link. Narrow with `parent` or `q`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-rankings

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only rankings whose title or path contains this text (e.g. electric, under-40k).

parameters.name: include_years
parameters.description: Also list past years' editions (default false).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
MotorTrend's site search: models, rankings and articles (reviews, news, features, comparison tests) matching a query, with type, title, summary, section, publish and update dates, tagged vehicles (year, make, model and submodel ids), image and link. `type` narrows to cars, rankings or reviews. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MotorTrend full specs of a trim
get.description:
The full specification sheet of one trim (style): MSRP, invoice and destination, trim and body, drivetrain, market class, safety rating; technical specifications grouped (engine, transmission, dimensions, weights, fuel economy, capacities, suspension, brakes, tires...), standard equipment by group, every factory option with its MSRP and invoice (colors with their color family and RGB), warranty and consumer information, crash-test results and editorial pros/cons. `sections` limits the response to some parts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motortrend-specs

parameters.name: style_id
parameters.description: Style id from a trim's `styles` in /model.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated parts to return: all (default), specs, standard, options, consumer, editorial.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
